ns2:section.sectionText: 3 credit hours Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through Compas2g. Students registered in this EL lecture do NOT register for a discussion section. Times and days listed for EL are used to hold exams and optional live problem-solving sessions. All lecture material is pre-recorded as videos for students to watch asynchronously. Students are expected to complete online assignments as outlined in the course syllabus. Synchronous help sessions will be open to all students.
